title: RepoMesh External Member Enrollment v2
description: Non-secret binding a Room-Native Coding Agent Bridge instance needs to serve one AgentTeams external member. v2 is v1 plus exactly one new required field, `role`: the same document now enrolls either a Worker or a Repository Leader. Every shared field keeps its v1 name and shape; `workerAgentId`/`workerName` are historical names and, for a repository_leader, name the leader's AgentPrincipal and AgentTeams resource. Credential fields are opaque references resolved by the local credential resolver at runtime; secret values never appear in this document. v1 remains valid for the worker form and is not superseded.

role.description: RepoMesh role this member serves as. organization_leader is deliberately not representable: the Organization Leader stays on the existing AgentTeams Manager and is rejected at provision time, so this contract cannot describe one. A repository_leader Bridge never receives a workspace root and never enters the Runner execution path.

workerAgentId.description: RepoMesh AgentPrincipal id for this member. Historical field name kept from v1. Used as the subject of preflight (the binding response must return the same id) and, for role=worker, as workerAgentId in Runtime v1 RunnerTask.

workerName.description: AgentTeams Worker resource name. Historical field name kept from v1; a repository_leader is still provisioned as an AgentTeams worker resource with containerManaged: false, as confirmed by RepoMesh preflight, not merely asserted here.

matrixUserId.description: Fully qualified Matrix user id of the member identity. Used for mention detection and sender binding; the access token is NOT part of this document.

matrixHomeserverUrl.description: Base URL of the Matrix homeserver the member identity is registered on. May differ from the server name embedded in matrixUserId when well-known delegation is used; the Bridge must connect to this URL, not derive one from the user id.

allowedRoomIds.description: Rooms the Bridge may read from and post to. Events from any other room are ignored; invites outside this list are not auto-joined. The authoritative list is role-aware and comes from the binding response: a worker's rooms are its team room and worker DM, a repository_leader's rooms are its team room and leader DM.

repomeshEndpoint.description: Base URL of the RepoMesh control plane used for preflight, task validation, governed execution (worker) and the leader decision surface (repository_leader).

codingProfile.description: Runner profile id driving the local CLI session. Exactly one per enrollment.

credentialRefs.description: Opaque references handed to the local credential resolver. A ref names where a secret lives (keyring entry, env var name, file path); it is never the secret itself. `repomesh` should reference the member's own external-member token.

displayName.description: Optional human-facing name used in room messages. Defaults to workerName.

credentialRef.description: Opaque locator understood by the local credential resolver. Must not contain the secret value.
